name: zimvisit-monorepo
description: ZimVisit - Zimbabwe's National Tourism Digitization & Compliance Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:operator" "npm run dev:gov" "npm run dev:traveler"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:operator && npm run build:gov && npm run build:traveler
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:operator && npm run lint:gov
scripts.install:all: cd apps/backend/nestjs && npm install && cd ../../operator-dashboard && npm install && cd ../../government-portal && npm install && cd ../../traveler-portal && npm install
